title: fix(scripts): dispatch-gates says a path-scheduled full-battery job does not run on the PR or in the merge queue
body:
Fixes #24073
Clause-②: no

## What

`dispatch-gates` now says, on the row a reader reads, that a path-scheduled CI job whose `if:` carries ci.yml's full-battery clause does not run on this PR or in the merge queue, and that its first run on the change is `main`'s push battery after the merge.

Scope is ruling 6243472660 (on #24171), letter B, term 2: the card's "Done when" items 1 and 2 only. Item 3 (a local command for the dogfood files) would be a new derived row and stays frozen. It is not in this PR.

## Why (measured at `a422f04f`)

The job `if:` reader already stripped the full-battery clause (`&& github.event_name != 'pull_request' && github.event_name != 'merge_group'`) as the expression's last conjunct, so the job's filter population could still be read. The fact the clause carries was then dropped. `jobFilterPopulation` returned `{ paths, outputs, dropped }`, the job-filtered row was `{ workflow, job, outputs, hits, dropped, steps }`, and neither renderer had a field to read. `dispatch-gates.data.mjs` is not on this path, so it is unchanged.

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack packages/runtime/src/route-ledger.ts`, the path PR #24009 changed:

```text
before (a422f04f), stderr:
  + 5 CI job(s) are scheduled BY YOUR PATHS and run 34 step(s) no family above names — NOT above. ...
      ⊘ NOT MEASURED — [ci.yml · Dogfood Regression Gate (${{ matrix.shard }}/3)] 5 step(s): Get pnpm store directory · Install dependencies · Build the dogfood package's dependency closure · Snapshot the working tree before the dogfood tests · Boot example apps and exercise real user flows
      ⊘ NOT MEASURED — [ci.yml · Dogfood Verify CLI] 3 step(s): Get pnpm store directory · Install dependencies · Verify example apps via the `objectstack verify` CLI

after (004ba7b4), stderr:
      ⊘ NOT MEASURED — [ci.yml · Dogfood Regression Gate (${{ matrix.shard }}/3)] ⛔ does NOT run on this PR or in the merge queue: its `if:` excludes the pull_request and merge_group events, so its first run on this change is `main`'s push battery, AFTER the merge — 5 step(s): Get pnpm store directory · Install dependencies · Build the dogfood package's dependency closure · Snapshot the working tree before the dogfood tests · Boot example apps and exercise real user flows
      ⊘ NOT MEASURED — [ci.yml · Dogfood Verify CLI] ⛔ does NOT run on this PR or in the merge queue: its `if:` excludes the pull_request and merge_group events, so its first run on this change is `main`'s push battery, AFTER the merge — 3 step(s): Get pnpm store directory · Install dependencies · Verify example apps via the `objectstack verify` CLI
```

The Temporal Conformance row carries the same clause, because its `if:` does. The Test Core and Build Core rows are unchanged, because theirs do not. stdout (the 49 commands) is byte-identical before and after (diffed).

## Change

- `jobIfReading(ifExpression)` returns `{ refs, fullBatteryOnly }`. `jobFilterOutputRefs` is that reading with the second half dropped: same refusals, same refs.
- `jobFilterPopulation`, `jobFilterPopulations` and `jobFilteredSteps` carry `fullBatteryOnly` onto each job row. `--json` gets it too, under `jobFilteredSteps.jobs`.
- `fullBatteryOnlyClause(row)` renders the one sentence from the flag, never from a job name. `jobFilteredNotMeasuredLine(row)` is the `--commands` / `--json` stderr row, pulled out of the inline template so the pin reads the line a dispatch is built from. The clause goes right after the job name, ahead of the step list. The plain rendering appends it to the row's own line.
- The plain rendering's header said "YOUR path puts this job on the PR". It now says the path schedules the job, on this PR unless its row says it does NOT.

No new gate, derived row, ratchet, `--tier` mandate or constant.

## Pin

The cases are in `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.self-test.mjs`, fast tier, in the existing sections:

- In the full-battery `if:` section, `jobIfReading` returns `fullBatteryOnly: true` for the stripped clause and `false` for the live spelling without it.
- In the path-scheduled-jobs section, LIVE on ci.yml for `packages/runtime/src/route-ledger.ts`, four checks run for each of Dogfood Regression Gate and Dogfood Verify CLI:
  - the row carries `fullBatteryOnly: true`;
  - the `--commands` line says "does NOT run on this PR or in the merge queue", ahead of the step list;
  - the plain row line says it too;
  - in place, the same row with the field stripped renders the statement in neither line.
- Negative control: Build Core, scheduled by the same path and run on the PR, carries `false` and no statement.

## Verification at `004ba7b4` (`git rev-parse --short HEAD`)

- `pnpm check:pm-dispatch-gates` (fast tier), exit 0, 396.9 s: `✓ dispatch-gates self-test (fast tier): 1913 cases pass; 6 slow section(s) deferred.`
- Both tiers, `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --self-test`: exit 0, `✓ dispatch-gates self-test: 2173 cases pass.` (fast 1913 case(s) in 406.7 s, slow 260 case(s) in 1201.5 s). The slow tier is the one CI runs only on `main`'s push and hourly runs.
- One-time ablation of the producer, using `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` in wrap mode:
  - The anchor `const fullBatteryOnly = eventFree !== expr;` was replaced by `const fullBatteryOnly = false;`. Anchor count went x1 to x0, and the blob went `b2836327f780` to `cf8939035532`.
  - Fast tier result: `✗ dispatch-gates self-test (fast tier): 7 of 1913 case(s) failed.` These are exactly the 7 predicted: the `jobIfReading` true case, plus three per dogfood job (the flag, the `--commands` line, the plain line). The in-place ablation cases and the Build Core control stayed green.
  - Restore proven: blob == HEAD (`b2836327f780`) and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` with no paths derives 32 commands; the change set is the two files vs merge base `a422f04fe`. All 32 ran with exit 0, each code captured before any pipe. `--ran` printed `✓ dispatch-gates --ran: 32 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 32 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 32 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3).` The same three-path derivation at `a422f04f` gives the identical set of 32.

## Acceptance notes

- Console Pin Gate's `if:` carries the same clause, so its row (for `.objectui-sha`) gets the statement from the same flag. No text is written per job.
- A check family derived through a full-battery job's filter, such as the console-pin families for `.objectui-sha`, keeps its matched-row provenance "CI job filter for 'Console Pin Gate' in ci.yml" with no WHEN. That family is on stdout as a local command the dev runs, so the dev never has to infer that the PR covers it. Not touched here, which keeps this PR inside the term 2 scope. No carrier.
- `dispatch-gates.self-test.mjs` has no named-battery roster to register against. Adding one would be a new constant under the freeze, so the cases sit in the existing sections.
- `skip-changeset`: `scripts/pm/**` publishes nothing.
